bioLead: Ben Carrillo is a Guatemalan artist, singer-songwriter, and creative director based in Los Angeles.
bioSecond: At just 15 years old, he left his home country and crossed the border on foot in pursuit of the American dream and a better future for himself and his family.
bioThird: Ben has collaborated with Latin music icon Thalía, opened for global superstar Bad Bunny, and delivered a standout performance on COLORS. In October, he released his third studio album, DREAMER, which earned critical recognition, including No. 29 on Rolling Stone’s 50 Best Latin Albums of 2025.
bioEnd: His single “Centroamérica” surpassed 500,000 streams across platforms within just four months. With co-signs from J Balvin, Feid, and Thalía, Ben continues to build his own path while proudly representing and uplifting the Latin immigrant community in the United States.
